assumptions: One primary prescribing interface, one clinical reference, one MAPS submission interface plus separate query access, one payer transport/clearinghouse, one AI model/OCR path and one initial device family.
Planning follows the repository Michigan-focused requirements; additional jurisdictions require explicit re-sizing. Do not infer actual site jurisdictions from those references.
Actual site count is unknown. F29 covers one representative acceptance cycle; each additional site must be sized after inventory.
Full product reserve is 25 percent above remaining package ranges; pilot P12 already contains its defect allowance.
Vendor certification, provider procurement, licensed clinical standards, pharmacy qualification, formal independent compliance review and hosting costs/calendar are not quoted.
New providers/sites/device families or policy redesign expand the baseline through explicit change control.
